en.headline: Beijing robotics firm plans dozens more autonomous retail stores in Hong Kong
en.dek: Galaxy Universal, which already operates fully autonomous shops in Kai Tak, Hung Hom and Wan Chai, aims to expand into tourist areas including theme parks.
body: Beijing-based Galaxy Universal Robotics plans to open dozens more fully autonomous robot-operated retail stores across Hong Kong, targeting high-footfall and tourist districts including Disneyland and Ocean Park, its founder and chief technology officer said.

Wang He told reporters that the company, which already runs shops in Kai Tak, Hung Hom and Wan Chai where humanoid robots handle ordering, picking and payment without remote control, wants to broaden the product range beyond solid packaged goods to items such as ice cream and hot food.

He said the firm has strengthened the robots’ Cantonese capabilities for the local market and sees Hong Kong as a bridgehead for global expansion. Galaxy Universal has raised more than 6 billion yuan and is valued at about US$3 billion. Wang expressed confidence that attractive products and strong tourist spending would support the business model in a high-rent city.

zh.headline: 銀河通用擬在港增設數十家全自主機器人零售店
zh.dek: 公司已在啟德、紅磡及灣仔開業，計劃拓展至人流密集區及主題樂園，並增加產品種類。
body: 北京銀河通用機器人公司創辦人兼首席技術官王鶴表示，計劃在香港人流密集地區及旅遊區增設數十家全自主機器人零售店，包括迪士尼樂園和海洋公園等地。
公司已在啟德、紅磡及灣仔開設店舖，由人形機器人自主感應環境、與顧客交流，並完成接單、取貨及支付全流程，毋須後台遙控。王鶴指現時主要售賣固體包裝產品，未來會探索雪條及熱食等受歡迎貨品。
他表示已加強機器人的廣東話能力，並視香港為走向世界的橋頭堡。公司截至三月已累計融資逾六十億元人民幣，估值約三十億美元。王鶴對在寸土寸金的香港取得成功表示有信心。
